feeds.title: Canadian Women's Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The Canadian Women's Foundation is a national leader in the movement for gender equality in Canada. We aim to be inclusive of diverse people across gender and sexuality spectrums. We focus our efforts on supporting those who face the most barriers and have the least access to relevant services. This includes people who identify as women, girls, trans, genderqueer, non-binary, and 2SLGBTQI+.

feeds.title: Canadian Small Business Women Blog
feeds.description: Dwania Peele launched Canadian Small Business Women to help bridge the gap between your dreams and reality. Canadian Small Business Women was created to provide a place for aspiring Canadian businesswomen to find the necessary resources to take their business from the planning stages to reality. We'll help you connect with experts, skills, and access to all the information you need to take your businesses to the next level.

feeds.title: Canadian Women's Chamber of Commerce Blog
feeds.description: Issues affecting women in business in Canada are profiled here by CEO Nancy Wilson, the CanWCC team and guest content from our members. CanWCC is a national not-for-profit organization built to address the two biggest challenges faced by women entrepreneurs and business owners in Canada: Systemic barriers to success and a lack of community connection. We strive to promote, elevate and nurture cultural values, wellness, and businesses that sustain both our communities and ourselves.

feeds.title: Erica Diamond
feeds.description: Hi, there! I'm Erica Diamond. I help busy women prioritize self-care so they can experience less stress, more calm, and greater joy every day! As a Certified Life Coach, Certified Yoga and Meditation Teacher, I help women completely transform their days to vibrate at a high energy frequency, and feel calm at the same time.

feeds.title: Women In Leadership For Life Blog
feeds.description: Women In Leadership For Life (WILL) is dedicated to supporting women in living a fully expressed life and to being their personal leadership best.Linda and Lillas, and guest bloggers from our Women In Leadership For Life community, bring you inspiration, wisdom, and practical tips on topics to help you live fully expressed and your personal leadership best.

feeds.title: Women Get On Board Blog
feeds.description: As a community of engaged women and men in Canada, Women Get On Board is committed to advancing women in the boardroom. Our team works towards this with the mission to connect, promote and empower the advancement of women to the boardroom.

feeds.title: Manitoba Association of Women's Shelters Blog
feeds.description: The Manitoba Association of Women's Shelters (MAWS) is dedicated to providing a unified voice for women, children, and all those who are affected by violence and abuse. MAWS members are dedicated to advancing and maintaining the well being of women and children in abusive situations.

feeds.title: Women's Health Collective Canada
feeds.description: Shining a spotlight on women's health.Women's Health Collective Canada was created by three of Canada's leading women's health and hospital foundations to break the barriers holding us back from providing women with the knowledge and care they deserve.

feeds.title: Elevate Women's Health Centre Blog
feeds.description: I, Shawna Dingman, have always believed that being a wife and mother of 3 as well as a chiropractor has made me better at understanding the complexity of women's health. My mission is to help women and children lead happy, healthy lives.

feeds.title: Women's College Hospital Foundation
feeds.description: Our Foundation is proud to support Women's College Hospital as a leader in women's health and broadening health care access and advancing equity in underrepresented groups. We are guided by our strong values and our commitment to building a better Canada by advancing health equity for women and for all.

feeds.title: Journey Woman
feeds.description: Journey Woman is the world's original solo travel publication for women, founded by the late Evelyn Hannon in 1994. In addition to publishing award-winning travel editorials with their contributing writers, they create a safe, inviting place where women can research, learn, and find inspiration to live the life of their dreams, with travel as a shared passion. Wade through their blog and learn more about travel tips, destinations, deals, offers, resources, books, stories, articles, events, webinars, and more.

feeds.title: Women That Give Blog
feeds.description: Women that Give is a Registered Charity, run by women Entrepreneurs and Professionals Volunteers, with a mandate: Its mission is to advance education by providing employability and entrepreneurial skills, training, workshops, and seminars to women in need, including women residing in shelters.

feeds.title: 100 Women Who Care Kawartha Lakes
feeds.description: The first 100 Women Who Care group was formed in November 2006 by Karen Dunigan of Jackson, Michigan, USA. 100 WWC Kawartha Lakes is a giving circle of women from the Kawartha Lakes who want to make a difference for local charities & NFP that service our community.

feeds.title: Muslim Moms of Canada
feeds.description: For all the Muslim moms living in Canada to get together, share ideas, events, network, and get inspired. We offer articles, events, reviews, and much more! Created by moms, Muslimmoms.Ca is a community portal to give voice to Muslim Mothers all over Canada and empower them.

feeds.title: Women in Leadership Foundation Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2001, Women In Leadership Foundation (WIL) delivers inspirational programs that bring women together to collaborate in the development of their leadership skills & create positive change in the future of women's leadership. We recognize, honor and respect the presence of all Indigenous people, past, present and future.

feeds.title: Best Health Magazine
feeds.description: Canada's magazine for women who care about their health, want to live better and feel great. Best Health Magazine covers every topic essential in a woman's life. From wellness to life advice to beauty trends, you'll find every topic you're looking for.

feeds.title: Women in Need Blog
feeds.description: WIN is organized as a community service cooperative which is a nonprofit form of a cooperative. Our purpose is to benefit the community through the provision of programs and services for supports women, trans, non-binary, and Two-Spirit people, and their families.

feeds.title: Newcomer Women's Services Blog
feeds.description: Newcomer Women's Services Toronto was founded by a group of Latin American refugees in 1983. For the past 30 years, we've been helping immigrant women and men from all around the world to become part of the wider community. This is where we'll be sharing stories about inspiring people. It's also a place to learn job search tips and fun ways to improve your English. We'll also share practical advice on how to settle into your new life.

feeds.title: Young Women in Business Blog
feeds.description: The highlights, recaps, and spotlights captured by our YWiB family. Young Women in Business is a community for emerging self-identified women leaders and professionals who want to create their own success. We provide young women and professionals with events, programs, and an engaged network of ambitious women, to help them become successful in their careers, their businesses, self-reflect, take on new challenges and develop skills.

feeds.title: Second Story Women's Centre
feeds.description: Second Story Women's Centre supports women and gender-oppressed people, provides safer spaces, and advocates for social change. SWC provides support, counseling, referrals, personal development programs, advocacy, volunteer engagement, wellness programs, youth programs, social opportunities for women, girls, and other gender-oppressed people.

feeds.title: QWIL Blog
feeds.description: Twenty-five years ago, QWIL began as a woman in a financial markets conference that aimed to empower and inspire young women to pursue their career goals in this field. As we have evolved, QWIL has expanded to include a wide diversity of industries, engaging voices across faculties, universities, and genders.

feeds.title: Women's Health Blog
feeds.description: The Women's Health Research Cluster is an international multidisciplinary network of researchers, clinicians, community partners, and trainees that work together to advance the health outcomes of women worldwide. We aspire to create a future where women can live equitably healthy lives from birth to old age.

feeds.title: Darren Lazare
feeds.description: Blog posts on women's health and vaginal rejuvenation. Written by Dr. Darren Lazare, Jahzel Misner and Jaylene Llewellyn.

feeds.title: Federation of Medical Women of Canada
feeds.description: The Federation of Medical Women of Canada (FMWC) is a national organization committed to the professional, social and personal advancement of women physicians and to the promotion of the well-being of women both in the medical profession and in society at large.

feeds.title: Women on the Road
feeds.description: Are you feeling held back because you don't have a travel partner? Not sure about traveling solo? This website is for women who have decided to see the world ON THEIR OWN. Forget the partner, forget the doubts - you can own this! Women on the Road exists to help women with the nuts and bolts of solo travel: how to plan a trip, how to stay safe, what to take, how to budget, how to avoid getting lonely - all the things you face before, during, and after you travel.

feeds.title: Office to Advance Women Apprentices (OAWA) Blog
feeds.description: The Office to Advance Women Apprentices Newfoundland and Labrador was established in 2009 with a mandate of increasing employment opportunities for women in the skilled trades. The office provides ongoing support to tradeswomen seeking work or already employed in the skilled trades. This includes providing career services, employment supports, and networking opportunities for tradeswomen.
